svg.text: The same ₹50,000 means three different things
Every life has its own Essential, Good to have and Premium. Read a row across.

More than enough. Worth it if your rooms get
More than you need. It buys you almost
₹50,000 is more than enough for one life, a good start for another, and not enough for the third.
For an Active Professional it is not even on the scale. Buy for the life you actually live, not for the spec sheet.
Each named device is the behind-the-ear-with-a-wire pick. Need a different body? At ₹1,00,000 the same budget buys
a Naida behind the ear or a Virto inside it; at ₹50,000 Terra has a behind-the-ear too. Which body you need is its own question.
